notes: Seed list is a hint. Live join/continue order fills roles. Tool identity irrelevant. Boss lease default 30 minutes (15–120); watchdog agent-less ~10m. After vacancy, GitHub-canonical claim_queue is FIFO; old boss rejoins at end. FULL PCM + FULL CGM 0.5.12 required — not a slim HSW/writing-direction-only subset.

role_fill.notes: First continuer = decision boss; next = coder1; next = coder2.

agents.notes: Seed hint for empty room; live join order wins when filling.

as_of_history.notes: Illustrative seed; append on failover — do not rewrite.

watchdog.notes: AGENT-LESS. Cron/Action/script only. No LLM. No peer agent. Watchdog != failover. ~10m liveness/nudge only.

pcm.notes: Full PCM for adopters. Continuity/checkpoints yes; still NOT the proposal/ACCEPT layer (that stays GitHub + PROPOSALS.md). Pin commit SHA; do not silently follow moving main. Do not vendor PCM source into ACS.

routing.readme_product_entry: writing-direction (MUST load; scan-first selective bold; do not apply HSW bold restraints)
routing.pr_issue_docs_commits: human-sounding-writing / hsw (MUST load for PR/issue titles+bodies, docs, commits)
routing.contract: docs/writing-routing.json + docs/ACS_VERIFY.md — application=must_load; human_facing_default; acs_prompt_inject after VALID
routing.html_reports_compare_appendable: human-sounding-writing / hsw (MUST; default ON; no per-report opt-in)

cgm.notes: FULL CGM 0.5.12 required for ACS and all hotloader adopters. Eight modules including human-output-naming. Not HSW+writing-direction only. MUST load modules per writing-routing.json (README→writing-direction; human-facing prose/HTML/compare/appendable→hsw default ON; basenames→hon). Pin SHA; validate with scripts/validate_content_system.py (full adapter); then apply acs_prompt_inject (application, human_facing_default, routes, apply_checklist). Do not vendor CGM source into ACS.

ticket_links.notes: Parent/child notes only; no full DAG engine.
